mathematical_claim: For any regular infinite cardinal, the stated constraint residual schema, semantic fixed-domain compactness, Boolean compactness, the fine complete ultrafilter principle, and complete filter extension are equivalent. No existence assertion is supplied. The successor obstruction applies uniformly to every infinite cardinal mu.
input_domain: Universe-polymorphic Lean types and cardinals; exact predicates, filters and ultrafilters; inherited exact integer algebra.
tested_surrogate: Fresh proof elaboration, exhaustive named theorem axiom audit, predecessor source equality, expected rejection controls. Mathematical universal conclusions derive from the proof terms, not from finite enumeration.
pass_means: Every compilation succeeds, every named theorem is audited, axiom dependencies satisfy the standard allowlist, input hashes are unchanged, predecessor theorem sources match, and false proof and placeholder controls are rejected for the expected reasons.
failure_means: No final PASS or claim that all proofs checked. Compiler, audit, integrity or resource failures must be reported separately.
non_claims: No uncountable existence, ZFC object-language derivation, relative consistency or independence theorem.
No classification of arbitrary derived residual systems or a new consistency strength.
No identification of the explicit integer cokernel with Mathlib right-derived limits.
